texts.text:
Be sure the Robot Odyssey I
disk is in the drive.

Then:
  To go to menu, press ESC.
  To save game, press S.

Remember to save your game if
you want to continue later.

A central robot can become your
friend.

THE MASTER COMPUTER


The master computer controls
many of the features of
Robotropolis.

Use the cameras to monitor
robot progress.

The computer can be turned off
and the robot released by
pressing the four buttons.

THE MINEFIELD

The walls in the map room are
in the same position as the
mines in the minefield.

Mines are set off when a robot
thrusts against them for more
than an instant.

Additional mines keep out non-
robots.

Robot communication is helpful.

Be sure the Robot Odyssey I
disk is in the disk drive.

Then press ESC.

THE FORCE FIELD TUNNEL


Robot relays pass key items
along.

Plan ahead for the return
journey.

The Sweeper 'Bot likes to keep
the hallways clean.

THE VENTILATION SHAFT

Counting chips can pick out
air tubes.

Be sure to pick the right
tube.
